posts.body:
Can someone tell me if this is something I should be worried about?
I can't say how and why it appears in a completely new (mz 1.5) project only with a (most recent visustella_core plugin enabled. And in the same way suddenly disappears and doesn't re-appear after contracting and extracting the console settings.
It appeared the first time in my main project where I had FOSSIL and tons of MV plugins enabled and after I started to experiment with Dragon Bones and after I completely disassembled the game I noticed that this... Violation would also appear in a completely new project. Can someone give me some clarity here please?

posts.author: OcRam
posts.body:
Hi there,
On scene changes (example after menu / on new map) I get this all the time.
Even without plugins enabled.
Also noticed this on battle with animations / events.
User can't see that lag on scene changes, but while moving on map / on battle scenes it it can be visible for eye.
So: If that violation is frequent while moving on map / on battles (and it bothers you) then there's something that's needs to be debugged and fixed...

posts.author: felsenstern
posts.body: It's really strange that I never before noticed any Violation. I can see this now all the time even in sample projects from other creators. I really wonder if that has something to do with me updating to the latest graphic drivers. Anyway thanks for the info that it's something perfect normal.
